question: Can QAD followed by on-policy teacher distillation extend the FP4 coverage that preserves closed-loop success?
ladder_invariant: Each level retains every FP4 tensor of the preceding level and promotes additional FP8 tensors to FP4; rounding and task difficulty are fixed.

initial_states.settle_action: seven raw simulator zeros including gripper; outside policy horizon
initial_states.paired_scope: environment initial state hashes; model noise is seeded per task, not per episode

selection.basis: Development trajectories only; publish every completed level of the ladder.
selection.rule: Evaluate the ladder in its declared order. Select the first promoted level whose development macro success drops at least 0.10 below the same-protocol BF16 reference. If none crosses that threshold, use calib (the maximal FP4 level) and report its actual degradation, including zero degradation.
selection.prohibited_inputs: Heldout outcomes must not select the recipe, teacher weight, training length, or checkpoints.

recovery.checkpointing_implementation: non-reentrant language/DiT/VL blocks; same setting for all training arms

continuation.optimizer_state: Both start a new Adam optimizer and the same learning-rate schedule.
continuation.probe_schedule: Within each selected optimizer update, every accumulation microbatch receives one single-sample teacher probe.
continuation.teacher_signal: Velocity-field MSE on student-visited observations, replaying identical noise and diffusion time on the full 40x132 action endpoint. Only the processor-defined 16x7 valid LIBERO output elements contribute; divide by their count.

primary: FP4 share of eligible and all checkpoint parameters
secondary: per-task paired outcomes and initial-state hashes
training wall time and peak memory
operator and engine latency reported independently
reporting.equal_budget_note: The continuation arms have equal demonstration steps, samples, and optimizer steps. OPD adds teacher labeling and student probe computation; these costs are measured separately, so this is not a claim of equal total FLOPs.
reporting.result_policy: Report actual results even if QAD or OPD does not improve; do not tune on heldout results or drop an unfavorable arm.
